findings.summary: Restored accepted review and attempt state were corrected so a retry creates a new immutable History record and authenticated review text is not re-persisted as an answer draft.
Improvement dismissal and editable retry now retain visible recovery actions and truthful copy when browser-local persistence cannot be updated or cleared.

History deletion now snapshots and validates History, active review, and matching draft storage before mutation; read or removal failure preserves the record and recovery state without claiming success.

Validation passed: 308 Interview Studio tests, two Package Registry tests, 11 local Playwright browser tests, JavaScript syntax, and diff checks. A broader Windows run's 11 unrelated platform/environment failures remain a documented limitation; protected Azure CI is required before merge.
